'''Ouma''' is an extinct [[Austronesian languages|Austronesian]] language of [[Papua New Guinea]]. It was restructured through contact with neighboring [[Papuan languages]], and it turn influencing them, before speakers shifted to those languages.{{citation needed|reason=UNESCO Atlas lists it as critically endangered but not extinct.|date=March 2023}}
